input.quote: 19.2 For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: Section 19.1 gives an undated professional/workmanlike Services warranty and a Services/Deliverables documentation-conformance warranty, and § 19.4 supplies re-performance, repair or replacement and a refund of Fees paid, so the remedy and Services-duration elements are already met. But § 19.2 caps the conformance warranty for Deliverables (and software delivered with them) at fifteen days and expressly ends any correction or refund obligation after that date, materially below the fallback floor of at least 90 days for software conformance. We therefore extend § 19.2 to ninety (90) days and confirm it reaches software delivered to us, leaving the § 19.4 remedies (which cross-refer to § 19.2) intact. Preferred-level extras not pursued: the 12-month software period and § 19.3's narrowing of malicious-code cover to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor" are noted only.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.

mappings.quote: Vendor warrants that Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel, in accordance with industry standards, this Agreement, and each Order Form.

mappings.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
mappings.quote: Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge.
Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation
ops.newText: For ninety (90) days after delivery, each Deliverable and software delivered to Customer will materially conform to its documentation

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the fifteen-day conformance warranty to ninety (90) days and made clear it covers software delivered to us, which is our fallback position on warranty duration; the repair, replacement and refund remedies in Section 19.4 are unchanged.
proposal.summary: Extend the 15-day Deliverable/software conformance warranty in § 19.2 to ninety (90) days
